title: SEC1: no operator docs for DKIM Ed25519 key generation
description: There is no documentation explaining how to generate a valid Ed25519 DKIM keypair for the config fields key_seed_b64 / public_key_b64. An operator hitting this for the first time will not know the key format (raw 32-byte seed base64, not PEM) and will get cryptic startup errors. A short note in README, CLAUDE.md, or a DKIM.md file explaining the key generation steps (e.g. using openssl or ed25519-dalek CLI) would prevent repeated support burden.
